description: Tronçons des itinéraires vélo pour le territoire de Cap Atlantique is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by CapAtlantique La Baule-Guérande Agglo. Existing cycling routes on the territory of Cap Atlantique (Asserac, Batz-sur-Mer, Camoël, Férel, Guérande, Herbignac, La Baule-Escoublac, La Turballe, Le Croisic, Le Pouliguen, Mesquer, Penestin, Piriac-sur-Mer, Saint-Lyphard, Saint-Molf). Routes are divided into sections. Coverage: CapAtlantique La Baule-Guérande Agglo. The portal shows the English title as "Sections of bicycle routes for the territory of Cape Atlantic" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is CapAtlantique La Baule-Guérande Agglo. Its keywords include pratique-sportive, developpement-economique, mobilite, velo, culture-tourisme, circuit. The listing shows 4 download or service links in JSON, CSV, ZIP. The listing shows 2025-04-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
